tools.quote: students are permitted to use assistive AI tools to check spelling, grammar and punctuation (i.e., use of in-built spell-checkers) in all written assessments excluding formal examinations e.g. invigilated exams.

Some GenAI tools additionally have the functionality to proofread a document. Students must consult the assessment brief which details what is appropriate use of GenAI in each specific assessment in accordance with the ‘Using GenAI in Assessment Scale’.
